feeds.title: MEN'S NON-NO Blog
feeds.description: MEN'S NON-NO is the male fashion magazine by Tokyo-based Shueisha. MEN'S NON-NO features an extensive array of menswear styles ranging from street, contemporary and high fashion, as well as more formal attire, making it appealing to a broad audience regardless of age and interest.

feeds.title: Tokyo Fashion Technology Lab Blog
feeds.description: Read about the latest developments in technology for the fashion industry with the Tokyo Fashion Technology Lab. 'TFL' (Tokyo Fashion Technology Lab) is a school that fosters a new age in fashion. It is for those who will be in charge of the fashion of the new era, a new idea of technology.

feeds.title: Samantha Mariko Blog
feeds.description: My name is Samantha Mariko, currently residing in Tokyo, Japan. I started this blog in late 2011, where I can share my style, modeling work, beauty, travels, music and anything that interests & inspires me.

feeds.title: Tokyobanhbao » Fashion
feeds.description: Welcome! I'm Tokyobanhbao, illustrator, in love with Paris, Tokyo and all things fashion. This blog has been my illustrated logbook and playground since 2007. I write fashion reviews and also post about food, travel and much more.

feeds.title: Tokyo Fashion
feeds.description: Harajuku-based online magazine dedicated to Tokyo street fashion, Japanese fashion and Harajuku style.

feeds.title: Fashion in Japan
feeds.description: Fashion in Japan brings you fresh photos of the latest fashion trends happening on the streets of Tokyo, Japan's Fashion Capital.

feeds.title: SALZ Tokyo Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Anji, a stylist & fashion blogger. An antique kimono addict & Harajuku fashion chameleon living in Tokyo. My goal is to spread the word and interest in kimono in Japan and overseas. I want to inspire with modern and alternative styling ideas as well as embracing traditional aspects.
